laneNotes: Both completed families print what they print FROM the controlling record, read at build time, and refuse to build if the record stops declaring it. Each carries a negative control in both directions: emptying a printed list stops the build, and a sentinel added to the record reaches the delivered bytes.

The nine counters were also read from the delivered bytes rather than believed from the builder. On both families addedGlyphs and glyphs-outside-boxes are computed by decoding the saved PDF's own content stream; on Hawaii the added-glyph count equals, exactly, the non-whitespace characters of the six written values.
No raster was taken in this container and no visual claim is made. visualDefects records that nobody has looked, not that there is nothing to see. Both families return BUILT_RASTER_PENDING.

The contract has no participant-completable requirement for a selection control, so that channel is the only one that keeps the disclosure check binding on them; the alternative disposition would have left them undisclosed by the contract. Every one is disclosed in participant-instructions.md regardless.
